source.label: Reduced norm boundary and ternary gap law

claims.summary: For N>=5 in every odd characteristic, remove the graded constant unit block of the actual reduced alternant boundary matrix by a polynomial Schur complement, preserving its marked last-coordinate ideal. A root-affine line over F_(p^e) with initial norm degree e*3*binom(N,4) and coprime selected cofactor norms proves boundary threshold 3*binom(N,4) over every characteristic-p field.
claims.assessment: Working proof, an algorithmic form of the existing norm-line criterion. Polynomial unit elimination preserves homogeneous kernels and the marking; the full-degree factor argument rules out a common divisor. Norm failure remains inconclusive.
claims.rationale: A route-specific implementation of prior Schur-hull and norm arguments, used in the exact nine-dimensional ternary certificate; no independent novelty claimed.
claims.next_action: Use the preserved source to investigate uniform small-prime cofactor primitivity, rather than expand a grid.

claims.summary: For cube dimension n=9 over every field of characteristic three, the degree-two boundary threshold is ell_0(3,47)=630. The actual reduced maximal minors have gcd one.
claims.assessment: Working computer-assisted proof from an explicit F81 root-affine line: fourteen unit columns removed, initial and adjacent norms of degrees2520 and2524 with gcd1. Independent PARI replay recomputes both full reduced polynomial determinants and matches every norm coefficient; FLINT controls also verify the complete original/frame identity.
claims.rationale: Discharges a previously open pre-stable threshold in statement4, beyond the all-odd normality already known through dimension ten. Exact fixed-parameter certificate valid over every field of characteristic three; no uniform-dimensional conclusion.
claims.next_action: Seek a general cofactor primitivity proof using the collision diagnosis and full marked source.

claims.summary: For every characteristic-three field F and every ell>=0, delta_F(9,ell+48,ell)=2ell+101 when ell<630 and 2ell+100 when ell>=630.
claims.assessment: Working proof: the coefficient of order47 in sqrt(1+T) vanishes mod3, so savings2 is available from origin order0; the new boundary makes savings3 available exactly from630; degree-three normality gives zero savings4 kernel at m47.
claims.rationale: An infinite slice of actual minimum degrees, obtained by combining the new polynomial threshold with established normality; advances the stated goal rather than only enlarging a finite rank inventory.
claims.next_action: Retain this slice while addressing the other pre-stable thresholds.
